incomplete_fix_evidence.summary: CVE-2010-1622 (2010) fixed mass-assignment via Object.getClass().getClassLoader() by adding a blocklist in CachedIntrospectionResults that filters the 'classLoader' property on Class. CVE-2022-22965 (Spring4Shell, 2022) bypasses this blocklist via the JDK9+ java.lang.Module path: Class.getModule().getClassLoader() provides an alternate route to the classLoader that the 2010 blocklist does not cover. Re-patched in Spring 5.3.18 with stricter type filtering that blocks class.module.* and restricts all Class-level property traversal.

fix_commits.cve_2022_22965: Spring 5.3.18 / 5.2.20 (stricter Class property filtering, blocks module path)

property_filter_evolution.v0_3.0.2: No filtering: all properties of Object.getClass() descendants are bindable via nested property paths, including classLoader.*
property_filter_evolution.v1_5.3.17: CVE-2010-1622 blocklist: CachedIntrospectionResults skips 'classLoader' and 'protectionDomain' property descriptors when the property's declaring class is java.lang.Class. Blocks class.classLoader.* but NOT class.module.classLoader.* (Module did not exist in 2010).
property_filter_evolution.v2_5.3.18: CVE-2022-22965 fix: CachedIntrospectionResults adds type-based filtering. When the bean class is (or is assignable from) java.lang.Class, ALL property descriptors are filtered except 'name'. Additionally blocks any property whose type is java.lang.ClassLoader or whose path traverses java.lang.Module.
